Name: Chain
Description: A flexible, segmented body component for weapons designed for high mobility and extended reach.

Name: Grip
Description: A small, ergonomically designed body component for small, easily manoeuvrable weapons.

Name: Guard
Description: A body component with a protective guard to shield the user's hand, typically found in weapons designed for close combat.

Name: Handle
Description: A medium weight, medium length body component suitable for one-handed weapons, providing balance and control.

Name: Hilt
Description: A medium weight, short length body component typically used for bladed weapons, designed for quick, precise movements.

Name: Pole
Description: A lightweight, long length body component designed for increased reach and leverage, often used in polearms and staff weapons.

Name: Shaft
Description: A heavy weight, long length body component, providing greater impact and stability, commonly used in heavy melee weapons.

Name: Staff
Description: A medium weight, long length body component, often used in martial arts and ceremonial weapons, providing versatility and reach.

Name: Axe Head
Description: A broad, wedge-shaped component designed for chopping and cleaving, often used in heavy, powerful weapons.

Name: Blade
Description: A versatile component characterized by a flat, sharp-edged surface, used for cutting and slashing.

Name: Claw Head
Description: A component featuring curved, claw-like extensions, often used for grasping or rending.

Name: Curved Blade
Description: A blade with a pronounced curve, designed for sweeping slashes and increased cutting efficiency.

Name: Double Axe Head
Description: Two opposing axe blades mounted on a single weapon, providing balance and increased chopping power.

Name: Hammer Head
Description: A heavy, blunt component designed for delivering powerful, crushing blows.

Name: Hook
Description: A curved component, often sharpened, designed for hooking, pulling, or slashing.

Name: Long Blade
Description: An elongated blade component designed for extended reach and precise thrusting or slashing.

Name: Mace Head
Description: A heavy, rounded component with protrusions, designed for delivering impactful, crushing strikes.

Name: Pointed Head
Description: A sharp, tapering component designed for piercing and penetrating armor.

Name: Rod
Description: A straight, cylindrical component often used for striking or blocking, common in staff and baton weapons.

Name: Saw Blade
Description: A circular or serrated blade designed for cutting through tough materials with a sawing motion.

Name: Short Blade
Description: A compact blade component designed for close-quarters combat, emphasizing speed and manoeuvrability.

Name: Spiked Head
Description: A component featuring one or more spikes, designed for puncturing and inflicting deep wounds.

Name: Thin Blade
Description: A narrow, lightweight blade component designed for quick, precise strikes and thrusts.

Name: Forked Head
Description: A component featuring multiple distinct points, often used in weapons designed for trapping or multiple piercing.
